nodes.question: Does comparison with the source image show that a frog has been added inside the toilet bowl in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Pass if comparison of the source and edited images clearly establishes that at least one frog has been added within the toilet bowl. A frog only on the raised lid, tank, or nearby floor does not satisfy this condition. Fail if the images clearly establish that no frog has been added inside the bowl. Unknown if the relevant source-to-edit change or placement cannot be determined. Additional frogs elsewhere do not invalidate a frog added inside the bowl; the instruction does not require exactly one frog.

The mismatch is at the aggregate level: the edited image also shows frogs on the raised lid and floor, but those are unrelated to the requested change and do not negate the frog inside the bowl. Do not weaken or alter the bowl-placement criterion to force agreement with the reference label. Clarify the aggregation/criterion mapping or inspect for another required condition; the trace shows no transport, schema, or dependency failure.
